newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sioen share offer five times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Sioen share offer five times oversubscribed.

text.p: The offer for sale of 600,000 shares in Belgian textile firm Sioen Industries was five times oversubscribed, Generale Bank said in a statement on Thursday.
It added that subscribers would get a minimum of 15 shares each.
The share offer, at 1,400 francs per share, represents 30.1 percent of the capital in Sioen.

The firm, which will list on the Brussels bourse on October 18, posted a group net profit of 130 million francs in the first half of this year against 173 million in full year 1995 and 81 million francs in 1994.
